author: Axiom II
title: v4.6.4 re-ranking (band-first) and top candidates report
abstract: Band-first re-ranking of v4.6.4 per-config summaries with strong penalty outside the [0.22, 0.29] void band; write SELECTION_v4.6.4_v2.json and print top-10.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, glob, re

ROOT = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim"
GLOB = os.path.join(ROOT, "sweep_results/v4.6.4/config_*/power_law_sim_summary_*_avg.json")
OUT  = os.path.join(ROOT, "sweep_results/v4.6.4/SELECTION_v4.6.4_v2.json")

files = sorted(glob.glob(GLOB))
rows = []
for f in files:
    try:
        js = json.load(open(f, "r", encoding="utf-8"))
        avg = js.get("avg_cycle_metrics", {})
        ptv = float(avg.get("percent_time_in_void", 0.0))
        cv  = float(avg.get("cycle_len_cv", 0.0))
        stab= float(avg.get("stability_score", 0.0))
        cid = re.search(r'summary_(.+?)_avg\.json$', os.path.basename(f)).group(1)
        rows.append({"cfg_id": cid, "path": f, "ptv": ptv, "cv": cv, "stab": stab})
    except Exception:
        continue

band_lo, band_hi, target = 0.22, 0.29, 0.255
half_band = (band_hi - band_lo)/2.0 if band_hi>band_lo else 0.035

def norm(vals, v, minimize=True):
    lo, hi = min(vals), max(vals)
    if hi == lo: return 1.0
    return (hi - v)/(hi - lo) if minimize else (v - lo)/(hi - lo)

cvs = [r["cv"] for r in rows] or [0.0]
stabs = [r["stab"] for r in rows] or [0.0]
ranked = []
for r in rows:
    dist = abs(r["ptv"] - target)
    closeness = 1.0 - (dist / half_band)
    closeness = max(closeness, 0.0)
    outside = 0.0
    if r["ptv"] < band_lo:
        outside = (band_lo - r["ptv"]) / (band_hi - band_lo)
    elif r["ptv"] > band_hi:
        outside = (r["ptv"] - band_hi) / (band_hi - band_lo)
    cvn = norm(cvs, r["cv"], minimize=True)
    stabn = norm(stabs, r["stab"], minimize=False)
    score = 0.6*closeness + 0.3*stabn + 0.1*cvn - 1.0*outside
    ranked.append({**r, "closeness": closeness, "outside_penalty": outside, "cvn": cvn, "stabn": stabn, "score": score})

ranked.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
out = {"ok": True, "counts": {"total": len(rows)}, "band": {"low": band_lo, "high": band_hi, "target": target}, "top10": ranked[:10]}
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
json.dump(out, open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
